description: This file contains unit tests for the InvokeCommandRegistry class in the ai.openclaw.app.node package. The tests verify the behavior of advertised capabilities and commands based on different feature flags, as well as the command lookup functionality. It references various command and capability protocols and uses JUnit assertions to validate expected behavior.

classes.name: InvokeCommandRegistryTest
classes.description: Unit test class for InvokeCommandRegistry, testing capabilities, command availability, and command lookup based on feature flags.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_respectsFeatureAvailability
methods.description: Test that capabilities advertised match the core capabilities when no optional features are enabled.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_includesFeatureCapabilitiesWhenEnabled
methods.description: Test that enabling optional capabilities includes them in the advertised capabilities.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_respectsFeatureAvailability
methods.description: Verify commands advertised match core commands without optional/ debug features.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_includesFeatureCommandsWhenEnabled
methods.description: Verify that enabling optional commands includes them in the advertised list.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_onlyIncludesSupportedMotionCommands
methods.description: Checks that only supported motion commands are included based on flags.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_splitsSmsSendAndSearchAvailability
methods.description: Tests separation of SMS send/search commands based on capabilities.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_includeSmsWhenEitherSmsPathIsAvailable
methods.description: Verifies SMS capability is available if either SMS read or send is enabled.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_excludesCallLogWhenUnavailable
methods.description: Ensures call log commands are not advertised when call log is unavailable.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_excludesCallLogWhenUnavailable
methods.description: Ensures call log capability is excluded when unavailable.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_includesVoiceWakeWithoutAdvertisingCommands
methods.description: Checks that voice wake capability is advertised without adding commands.

methods.name: find_returnsForegroundMetadataForCameraCommands
methods.description: Tests retrieval of command metadata, including foreground requirement, for specific commands.

methods.name: find_returnsNullForUnknownCommand
methods.description: Verifies lookup returns null for an unknown command.
